title: Balance
description: A merchant's balance from the double-entry ledger (v2). Amounts are integer cents. `available` can be paid out; `reserve` is held back from each capture and released after the hold.

livemode.description: true for a live-mode key (sp_live_...), false for test mode (sp_test_...). The two modes never mix (v2).

available.description: Can be paid out now. Negative only if refunds took more than was available.

reserve.description: Held back from captures; moves to available after the hold.

next_release.description: The oldest reserve still held: how much and when it is released. Null if nothing is held.
